title: New SHL Assessment Identifies Skills For AI-Ready Workforce
text:
Podcast
New SHL Assessment Identifies Skills For AI-Ready Workforce
In this episode of the Josh Bersin Company’s “What Works" podcast, Sara Gutierrez, Chief Science Officer at SHL highlights the trust gap between employees and employers, and how organizations can de-risk AI transformation by assessing and increasing AI readiness.
Listen Now:
Discover how organizations will gain competitive edge from identifying and scaling the skills that drive performance in an AI-powered world.
Drawing on SHL's trusted
Talent Intelligence
and research of more than a million people, hear how various job-levels approach AI usage in the workplace differently, what makes trust the biggest barrier to progress, and why despite most organizations providing their employees access to AI tools, most still lack the workforce readiness to use them well.
Sara introduces SHL's
AI Readiness Model
built on four factors and eight measurable skills – that make up the DNA of the “Superworker” – to help organizations understand which people in the workforce are AI ready and what gaps will hold you back. The conversation covers the durable "human" skills that ground an AI-enabled career and how organizations can frame assessment as a tool for growth rather than judgment to build AI ready workforces.
Speakers
Kathi Enderes
SVP, Global Industry Analyst, The Josh Bersin Company
Sara Gutierrez
Chief Science Officer, SHL
